# ItiMaker

> > ItiMaker is a comprehensive travel planning platform offering destination guides, itineraries, and budget tips for exploring Europe, Turkey, Cyprus, and beyond in 2026.

ItiMaker provides detailed travel resources including walking tours, cultural attractions, accommodation guides, and local dining recommendations across Mediterranean destinations and European cities. The platform specializes in budget-friendly travel planning with practical tips for first-time visitors and experienced travelers alike.

## Key Topics

- 2026 travel planning
- Budget travel tips
- European destinations
- Mediterranean travel
- Cyprus beaches (Agia Napa)
- Turkey coastal towns (Alaçatı)
- France cultural sites (Arles, Avignon, Lille)
- Spain destinations (A Coruña, Alcúdia, Albarracín)
- Walking tour itineraries
- Accommodation booking guides
- Restaurant recommendations
- Cultural attractions
- Historic landmarks
- Van Gogh heritage sites
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
